pluginId.description: The ID of the plugin for which we are attempting to exchange the code for an access token for.

principalId.description: The ID of the principal to exchange the code for an access token for, or alternatively ~self, when the target is the current user principal.

pluginAuthenticationData.description: The data to exchange the code with. This is opaque data that is bespoke to the plugin and the plugin's authentication flow.
